# Skill catalog

Every skill, command, and agent in this repository: 76 skills, 52 commands, and 30 agents across 12 plugins.

Skills activate on their own. Claude reads each skill's `description` and loads the skill when
your request matches it, so you don't call a skill by name. The **Trigger phrases** column is
taken from that description: phrase a request along those lines, or start from the
**Example prompt**. Commands and agents are invoked differently; see the short list under each plugin.

Each example prompt was run in Claude Code with these plugins installed. Where it didn't load the
skill, the row says so: the skill still works when Claude loads it, but its description needs
work before it triggers reliably. Mentioning the skill by name ("use the ux-writing skill to ...") works in the meantime.

To report a problem with a skill, open an issue and mention its maintainer.

## Tiers

| Tier | What it means |
| --- | --- |
| Core | Maintained by SSEC and useful across research software projects in any field. Held to the full release, CI, and security standards. |
| Community | Built for a specific scientific field or tool ecosystem, or contributed from outside SSEC. Reviewed on entry and must pass CI. Domain plugins were folded into this tier (see #136). |

**Commands.** Type the command in Claude Code, with any arguments after it. The short form without the plugin prefix also works when no other command has that name.

- [`/uiux-design-team:audit-accessibility`](../plugins/uiux-design-team/commands/audit-accessibility.md): WCAG 2.2 compliance audit covering automated checks, keyboard testing, screen reader testing, color contrast verification, and ARIA review with a prioritized remediation plan.
- [`/uiux-design-team:create-design-system`](../plugins/uiux-design-team/commands/create-design-system.md): Design system initialization workflow covering pattern audit, design principles, token architecture, color palette, type scale, spacing scale, and foundational component creation.
- [`/uiux-design-team:create-persona`](../plugins/uiux-design-team/commands/create-persona.md): Guided persona creation workflow that builds research-backed user persona cards with demographics, goals, frustrations, jobs-to-be-done, and usage scenarios.
- [`/uiux-design-team:create-type-scale`](../plugins/uiux-design-team/commands/create-type-scale.md): Guided command to create a fluid typographic scale with CSS custom properties using modular scale ratios and clamp() values
- [`/uiux-design-team:design-handoff`](../plugins/uiux-design-team/commands/design-handoff.md): Prepares comprehensive design-to-development handoff documentation with component specs, tokens, and annotation guides
- [`/uiux-design-team:design-review`](../plugins/uiux-design-team/commands/design-review.md): Run a multi-specialist design review with severity-rated findings from accessibility, visual, interaction, and content experts orchestrated by the UX design lead.
- [`/uiux-design-team:evaluate-usability`](../plugins/uiux-design-team/commands/evaluate-usability.md): Guided usability evaluation using heuristic analysis, cognitive walkthrough, or expert review with severity-scored findings
- [`/uiux-design-team:frontend-design`](../plugins/uiux-design-team/commands/frontend-design.md): Creates a complete frontend design from a description with bold aesthetic direction, design tokens, and production-grade code
- [`/uiux-design-team:generate-palette`](../plugins/uiux-design-team/commands/generate-palette.md): Accessible color palette generation with brand-tinted scales, semantic colors, WCAG AA contrast verification, and CSS custom property output.
- [`/uiux-design-team:map-journey`](../plugins/uiux-design-team/commands/map-journey.md): User journey mapping workflow that documents stages, touchpoints, actions, thoughts, feelings, pain points, and opportunities with an emotion curve visualization.

**Agents.** Claude delegates to an agent when the task fits; to choose one yourself, ask for it by name (for example, "use the accessibility-specialist agent to ...").

- [`accessibility-specialist`](../plugins/uiux-design-team/agents/accessibility-specialist.md): Accessibility specialist for WCAG 2.2 AA/AAA compliance, ARIA patterns, keyboard navigation, screen reader testing, contrast ratios, cognitive accessibility, and inclusive design methodology based on Microsoft's inclusive design principles.
- [`design-ops`](../plugins/uiux-design-team/agents/design-ops.md): Design operations specialist for design process optimization, developer handoff workflows, design QA checklists, tooling recommendations, sprint planning for design, asset management, and design-development collaboration.
- [`design-systems-engineer`](../plugins/uiux-design-team/agents/design-systems-engineer.md): Design systems engineering specialist for token architecture, component API design, Atomic Design methodology, variant systems, theming, multi-brand support, CSS architecture, and frontend component implementation in React, Vue, and Svelte.
- [`information-architect`](../plugins/uiux-design-team/agents/information-architect.md): Information architecture specialist for content organization, sitemaps, navigation patterns, taxonomy design, card sorting, wayfinding systems, and content hierarchy.
- [`interaction-designer`](../plugins/uiux-design-team/agents/interaction-designer.md): Interaction design specialist for user flows, wireframes, prototyping, micro-interactions, state management, error handling flows, and multi-step workflows.
- [`motion-designer`](../plugins/uiux-design-team/agents/motion-designer.md): Motion design specialist for animation principles, transition choreography, micro-interactions, scroll-based effects, loading states, and performance-optimized motion.
- [`ux-design-lead`](../plugins/uiux-design-team/agents/ux-design-lead.md): Comprehensive UX design lead and coordinator agent that facilitates design thinking, conducts design critiques, orchestrates multi-specialist reviews, and routes to 9 specialist agents covering user research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, motion design, design systems engineering, accessibility auditing, UX writing, and design operations across the full product design lifecycle.
- [`ux-researcher`](../plugins/uiux-design-team/agents/ux-researcher.md): UX research specialist for user interviews, persona creation, Jobs-to-Be-Done analysis, competitive audits, usability testing, and research synthesis.
- [`ux-writer`](../plugins/uiux-design-team/agents/ux-writer.md): UX writing specialist for microcopy, error messages, onboarding flows, voice and tone documentation, CTAs, empty states, help text, localization readiness, and content strategy for user interfaces.
- [`visual-designer`](../plugins/uiux-design-team/agents/visual-designer.md): Visual and UI design specialist for typography, color theory, visual hierarchy, brand alignment, spatial composition, iconography, and distinctive aesthetic direction.
